title: agent-directory/1: the agents a viewer can discover (DEC-0104)
description: A derived view, never authority: who may call an agent stays its grant. An estate's directory comes from its record's placements and is read by the owner's own sessions (T0, T1); an organization's comes from its active share registrations and its own machines, and its members read the listed entries. No person, machine, grant or capability is in it.

source.description: estate: an owner's record; organization: an organization's registrations.

viewer.description: owner: the estate's owner (every placement, unlisted included); admin: the organization's administrator (every entry, unlisted included); member: a member of the organization (listed entries only).

listed.description: A discovery flag the publisher of the directory sets; an unlisted agent is still called by whoever holds its grant.
